predictions.articleTitle: Leatherhead vs Wingate & Finchley Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Open-Game Scoring Risks
predictions.coreRecommendation: Support Leatherhead on the Home Win / Draw line alongside Over 2.5 goals and BTTS Yes in a high-tempo Isthmian Premier matchup.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw: Leatherhead's 2.00 goals-per-game attack targets a Wingate & Finchley away backline conceding 2.29 goals per trip, while Wingate's road scoring floor keeps the 2:2 draw live (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals & BTTS Yes: A 3.66 combined lambda and 70.8% Over 2.5 / 70.2% BTTS Poisson baseline align with both clubs' 3.53 and 3.80 league goal averages (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: High-scoring Leatherhead host leaky-away Wingate with both attacks firing.

spf.comment: Leatherhead's superior league form and 2.00 goals-per-game edge support a 2:1 home win, while their 2W-2D-3L home record and Wingate's 1.86 away scoring rate require retaining the 2:2 draw rather than forcing a single outcome.

over_under.comment: A 3.66 combined lambda, 70.8% Poisson Over 2.5 rate, and league averages above 3.5 total goals per match point decisively to three or more goals.

btts.comment: Both sides carry >81% Poisson scoring probabilities and <19% clean-sheet projections, backed by Leatherhead's 23 and Wingate's 29 league goals conceded.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Leatherhead's attacking edge over Wingate's porous away defence, while 2:2 captures both teams' recent draw and two-goal concession patterns.

goals.comment: Three goals (21.0%) and four goals (19.2%) lead the Poisson total-goals distribution and match the projected 2:1 and 2:2 game scripts.

bqc.comment: Draw-Win reflects Leatherhead breaking down tired visitors after a competitive opening half, while Win-Draw covers an early home lead pegged back late.
